text:
lena morales: hi team! first day here. quick checklist Qs: who sets up HubSpot + shared sequences, who owns Intercom seats for CS handoffs, and where are the latest one-pagers for platform integrations? thanks!

ryan (sales-ops): welcome lena! HubSpot seat + sequences go through Sales-Ops. I opened ticket SO-9401. Sequences we usually copy from "New AE Outbound" template unless you want a different cadence. DM me your okta email to finish.

jess it: @lena morales send your laptop hostname and mac if you want device auth. HubSpot provisioning needs Okta name and email in the same browser session.

marta cs: Intercom seats are managed by CS. I'll add you to the team workspace and enable conversation assignment. Need your Intercom email (usually same as Okta). We hand off leads via the "CS Handoff" tag + shared inbox.

lena morales: DM'd my okta email and laptop host. also: where do i find the customer one-pagers and the "handoff script" for warm leads?

ed manager: welcome! Week 1 plan: 1) shadow Marta on 3 handoffs, 2) review 1-pagers and battlecards, 3) join mock handoff Fri AM. I'll schedule pairing. Goal: own first CS handoff by W2.

onboarding-bot: Welcome lena morales! Onboarding checklist: https://redwood.internal/onboarding/lena-m Status: HubSpot (pending), Intercom (pending), HR forms (complete).

ryan (sales-ops): HubSpot seat active ✅. Sequences template copied to your account: Sales > Sequences > New AE Outbound. If you want a CS-focused sequence tell me and i'll create one.

marta cs: Intercom seat active ✅. Added you to "CS-Team" inbox and given access to shared notes. Handoff script: https://notion.redwood/cs/handoffs (look at section "Warm Lead Handoff").

jess it: Gong and recording permissions auto-provision after HubSpot SSO. If you need manual enable for call recording let me know. Also set your timezone in profile to see correct timestamps.

lena morales: confirmed HubSpot and Intercom access, thanks! last Q: quick voicemail + email templates for handoffs?

marta cs: Voicemail: "Hi, this is Marta from Redwood Inference on behalf of Lena. Lena will follow up to discuss next steps. Please leave your name and best callback number." Email template for handoff: short subject "Intro: [Customer] [Context]" and body with 3 bullets: what they need, next step, proposed times. I'll drop the templates in the Notion page.

ed manager: nice! also see battlecard "Security & Deploy Options" for any compliance questions. Ping Enablement for deeper technical collateral.

lena morales: perfect, appreciate the help. excited to get started :smile:
